document.abstract: In the modern world of DTV we have, perhaps rashly complicated our lives beyond all reason. For various techno-political reasons we now have to deal with TV formats that come in an abundance of flavours. 702 worst case!! We have progressive or interlace, in a multitude of field or frame rates. You as users or originators of DTV programming may have to deal with all these formats.
